Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up from BlueOrbit: starting next Monday they'll switch marketplace usage files to UTC daily-rollover and report amounts in EUR. They asked us to avoid any customer-facing bill surprises. Thoughts?

Evan - Billing: Key asks: persist raw_partner_currency and raw_amount_minor, capture ingest_fx_rate, and convert at invoice-generation time. Prefer "round half away from zero" on invoice lines. Also propose a 48h reconciliation window for late corrections.

Tara (Eng): On ingestion we'll add columns: partner_currency, partner_amount_minor, fx_rate_at_ingest, normalized_utc_day. Default ingest behavior: normalize by event timestamp -> UTC day. Add feature-flag legacy_local_day_mode for partners that request PST behavior.

Luca (BlueOrbit): We'll include a file-level currency_header and current_rate metadata. We'll also provide a one-week sandbox with both old (USD PST) and new (EUR UTC) files for testing.

Maya (Partnerships): Good. Action items: Tara to open PR for schema + feature flag (ETA: tomorrow EOD), Evan to update billing runbook and sample journal entries for EUR->USD conversion (ETA: 48h), BlueOrbit to hand over sandbox files (owner Luca). ops-bot: Monitor ingest_errors and currency_mismatch_rate for 72h after cutover.

ops-bot: Alert scheduled: monitor ingest_errors for BlueOrbit cutover on 2026-07-06T00:00:00Z.

Evan - Billing: One more policy: if a UTC cutover causes >7% daily usage delta for a customer in first 3 days, create a temporary credit hold and notify Partner Ops for review.

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after initial ingest checks.
